children: Basis bids for soybeans and corn loaded on barges and delivered to U.S. Gulf Coast terminals continued to weaken on Wednesday, though futures prices fell back from the previous day's rally, which drove farmer sales in the cash markets.
CIF offers for soybean barges loaded in September and October fell by 1 cent each.
CIF bids for corn fell by 3 cents for barges loaded in September.
Exporters sold 202,000 metric tons of soybeans to China for 2026/2027 delivery, according to the U.S. Department of Agriculture.
A Reuters poll of analysts estimated export sales of new crop corn for the week ending Aug. 27 at 500,000-1,600,000 metric tons.
Analysts polled estimated export sales of new crop soybeans at 1,400,000-2,500,000 tons.
CBOT December corn (CZ26) settled down 2-1/2 cents on Wednesday at $5.43-1/2 a bushel.
CBOT November soybeans (SX26) settled down 7-1/2 cents at $13.10-1/4 per bushel.
